This dataset contains the nine (9) point cloud files of the RCMP Dog Kennels and Runs. Only the interior was captured by the Capture2Presev team on 31st July, 2019. The nine (9) scans were collected with the Leica BLK 360 and registered with AutoDesk ReCap Mobile and Pro V.6.1.
